    composer.
  Build order:
  1. The gateway, pairing, inbox, Screen view, composer and Approve buttons. That alone lets you drive sessions remotely.
  2. PWA install and push.
  3. The Chat view.
  4. The launcher and diff review.
  On the installs, which are done but not committed:
  - ./install.sh and docs/install.md cover Linux, Windows (WSL2) and macOS. I tested a fresh install and a rerun that upgrades a running daemon; it kept its sessions.
  - The Linux-only calls are ported, and the whole workspace compiles for macOS. It hasn't been run on a Mac yet, so the doc lists what to check on your first run.
  - The work laptop clones from GitHub, so the work has to be pushed before you can install there.
  - The macOS check toolchain sits in target/scratch-toolchain (about 840 MB, gitignored); cargo clean removes it.
